description.value: The study investigated how medial orbitofrontal and periaqueductal gray functional connectivity antagonistically modulates physical and social pleasure expectancy and problem drinking during resting state and alcohol cue exposure.

spans.text: Here, we investigated the competing roles of the reward and pain circuits in PSP expectancy and problem drinking in humans.
